english.Ps.1.1: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
english.Ps.1.2: but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
english.Ps.1.3: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
english.Ps.1.4: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
english.Ps.1.5: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
english.Ps.1.6: For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
english.Ps.19.1: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.
english.Ps.19.2: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
english.Ps.19.3: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
english.Ps.19.4: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
english.Ps.19.5: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
english.Ps.19.6: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
english.Ps.19.7: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
english.Ps.19.8: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
english.Ps.19.9: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
english.Ps.19.10: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
english.Ps.19.11: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
english.Ps.19.12: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
english.Ps.19.13: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
english.Ps.19.14: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
english.Ps.19.15: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
english.Ps.23.1: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.
english.Ps.23.2: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
english.Ps.23.3: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
english.Ps.23.4: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
english.Ps.23.5: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
english.Ps.23.6: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.
english.Ps.25.1: To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.
english.Ps.25.2: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
english.Ps.25.3: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
english.Ps.25.4: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
english.Ps.25.5: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.
english.Ps.25.6: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
english.Ps.25.7: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.
english.Ps.25.8: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
english.Ps.25.9: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
english.Ps.25.10: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
english.Ps.25.11: For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
english.Ps.25.12: What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
english.Ps.25.13: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
english.Ps.25.14: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
english.Ps.25.15: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
english.Ps.25.16: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
english.Ps.25.17: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
english.Ps.25.18: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
english.Ps.25.19: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
english.Ps.25.20: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
english.Ps.25.21: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
english.Ps.25.22: Redeem Israel, God, out of all his troubles.
english.Ps.37.1: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
english.Ps.37.2: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
english.Ps.37.3: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
english.Ps.37.4: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
english.Ps.37.5: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
english.Ps.37.6: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
english.Ps.37.7: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
english.Ps.37.8: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.
english.Ps.37.9: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.
english.Ps.37.10: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
english.Ps.37.11: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
english.Ps.37.12: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
english.Ps.37.13: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
english.Ps.37.14: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
english.Ps.37.15: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
english.Ps.37.16: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
english.Ps.37.17: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.
english.Ps.37.18: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
english.Ps.37.19: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
english.Ps.37.20: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.
english.Ps.37.21: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
english.Ps.37.22: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
english.Ps.37.23: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
english.Ps.37.24: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
english.Ps.37.25: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
english.Ps.37.26: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
english.Ps.37.27: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
english.Ps.37.28: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
english.Ps.37.29: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
english.Ps.37.30: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
english.Ps.37.31: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
english.Ps.37.32: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
english.Ps.37.33: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
english.Ps.37.34: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
english.Ps.37.35: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
english.Ps.37.36: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
english.Ps.37.37: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
english.Ps.37.38: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
english.Ps.37.39: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
english.Ps.37.40: Yahweh helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.
english.Ps.51.1: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.
english.Ps.51.2: (The heading continues from the verse before it; in English it is one sentence.)
english.Ps.51.3: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.
english.Ps.51.4: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.
english.Ps.51.5: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.
english.Ps.51.6: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
english.Ps.51.7: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.
english.Ps.51.8: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
english.Ps.51.9: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
english.Ps.51.10: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
english.Ps.51.11: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.
english.Ps.51.12: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
english.Ps.51.13: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.
english.Ps.51.14: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
english.Ps.51.15: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.
english.Ps.51.16: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.
english.Ps.51.17: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.
english.Ps.51.18: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.
english.Ps.51.19: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
english.Ps.51.20: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.
english.Ps.51.21: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.
english.Ps.117.1: Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
english.Ps.117.2: For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!
english.Ps.121.1: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
english.Ps.121.2: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
english.Ps.121.3: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
english.Ps.121.4: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
english.Ps.121.5: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
english.Ps.121.6: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
english.Ps.121.7: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
english.Ps.121.8: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
english.Ps.150.1: Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
english.Ps.150.2: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!
english.Ps.150.3: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!
english.Ps.150.4: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
english.Ps.150.5: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!
english.Ps.150.6: Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
